classification.difficultyReason: Read five bar heights, form xf products and divide by n=20. This is one linked procedure with no scaffold. It has no zero-frequency bar and no table to convert.

content.prompt: Calculate the mean from this frequency histogram.

answer.worked:
Scores $5,6,7,8,9$ have frequencies $2,5,6,4,3$.

$$\begin{align*}\sum f&=2+5+6+4+3\\\sum f&=20\\\sum xf&=10+30+42+32+27\\\sum xf&=141\\\bar{x}&=\frac{\sum xf}{\sum f}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{141}{20}\\\bar{x}&=7.05\end{align*}$$
